integrity: Complete analytic proof and standalone exact-identity checker supplied. Numerical diagnostics support but do not substitute for asymptotic proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Proved for Euclidean flat two-tori, uniform independent vertices and shortest geodesic edges. Extremal bounds concern the large-vertex coefficient; no finite-n global ordering or shape-uniform remainder is proved. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp asymptotic contractibility rates for random minimizing geodesic polygons on flat two-tori
